name: Gardens of the Crystal Palace
description: Escape the city buzz and let the kids roam free in these stunning gardens. They'll love spotting the resident peacocks while you enjoy breathtaking views of the Douro.
longDescription:
The Gardens of the Crystal Palace offer a week-long opportunity for families to explore one of Porto's prominent green spaces. This event provides open access to the gardens, encouraging visitors to engage with the natural environment and the various features within the park. It functions as a public invitation to utilize the recreational facilities and observe the landscape design of the area.

Visitors can expect a relaxed outdoor atmosphere suitable for all ages. The expansive grounds provide ample space for children to move freely, and the presence of peacocks adds an element of wildlife observation. Adults can appreciate the panoramic vistas of the Douro River, which are visible from various points within the gardens. The event is designed for a family audience, with no specific duration for visits, allowing for self-paced exploration.

Entry to the Gardens of the Crystal Palace is free of charge, and no tickets are required. The venue, located on Rua de Dom Manuel II, is accessible by public transport. It is a walk from the Aliados metro station, and several bus lines serve the area. The gardens are generally accessible for prams and wheelchairs, though some paths may have gradients.
